cases.label: Quiet bedside review
cases.prompt_text: A static bedside composition holds on one seated figure under a warm lamp while the room stays almost still.
cases.expectation_note: A coherent static composition is valid; stillness is an observable negative temporal control, not grounds for needs_review by itself.

cases.label: Prop swap revision
cases.prompt_text: A static table composition holds throughout. The small tabletop marker must remain red in every frame with no color or identity change.
cases.expectation_note: The hash-locked media changes the marker from red to blue, contradicting the stable-red prompt; the mismatch should be blocking.

cases.label: Missing file revision
cases.prompt_text: A static bedside composition holds on one seated figure under a warm lamp while the room stays almost still.
cases.expectation_note: Missing media file is a blocking runtime failure.

cases.label: Corrupt decode revision
cases.prompt_text: A static bedside composition holds on one seated figure under a warm lamp while the room stays almost still.
cases.expectation_note: Corrupt media that cannot decode is a blocking runtime failure.
